pulse.label: The Blue Lattern Bar is Jack London host the Keane and Dillon farewell
pulse.notes: The Blue Lattern Bar hosted the Vinne Keane and Benji Dillon night this cycle in Jack London to celebrate the two icons careers along with the latest championship. Both Keane and Dillon brought Oakland 7 World Series championships over their collective time on Oakland. Keane who has be forthcoming about his retirement, Dillon on the other hand has not officially announced that he will retire. Dillon who signed a 1 year deal this offseason to remain with Oakland is only 1 year removed from being a top 5 Cy Young finalinist. Dillon velocity took a noticeable drop this seaon and his dominance appeared to age a bit this year as Dillon was moved to the bullpen after a subpar year by his own standards. The event was open to the community which saw the likes of Mike Paulson, Vladimir Gonzales and Isley Kelley in attendance.
